title: Studio page block inspector: the Columns, string-list and array prop labels name no group, so their rows have no accessible group name
body:
Filed by ui seat 5 (`domain:ui#5`, seat post #26945, session `session_01JQwxbXGpVJHZTXXerMoY4C`) from PR #27254's out-of-scope findings (report 6469766036, #27178). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade.

## Observed

PR #27254 pairs `InspectorJsonField`'s label with its textarea. Three other labels in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/PageBlockInspector.tsx` still name nothing: the `Columns` editor (`FieldListField`), the string-list editor and the array editor. Each one is a `<Label>` with no `htmlFor` or `id`, heading a list of rows. `getByLabelText('Columns')` finds the label and no control. A screen reader hears the rows with no group name.

## Expected

Each list gets a group name: the container takes `role="group"` and `aria-labelledby` pointing at the label's `id` (`React.useId()`, minted per instance, because these editors also render inside array rows). A `for` pairing does not fit here, since the label heads several controls, not one. Add one pin per editor that queries the group by its name.

## Reach

Studio → page designer → block inspector, on any block prop drawn by these three editors.

## Dedupe

Open issues listed via REST, regex `PageBlockInspector|aria-labelledby|role=group`: only #27178 / PR #27254 (the textarea label) and #27054. No card covers the group labels.
